calls.title: Ryanair Enterprise Trial - GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team is actively working on a $220,000 UK-based financial trial, aiming to align efforts with contract renewals occurring in August-September 2024. Scott Keller emphasized the importance of migration planning for 100 experiments and feature flags, with Liam set to lead after a handover from Pat Lee. However, there are concerns regarding limited user engagement on the internal trial platform, Retool, prompting Logan Bates to investigate analytics capabilities. Proactive customer communication is being prioritized to avoid stagnation in trial usage, alongside a structured leadership transition to ensure continuity in managing key accounts. The urgency to improve trial tracking and customer interactions is critical to closing upcoming contracts and enhancing customer satisfaction.
calls.keywords: POC success plan, Retool usage, Lead water line replacement, UK financial client, Contract renewal, Migration effort
calls.action_items:
**Scott Keller**
Send a ping and follow-up email to the client regarding the updated POC success plan and meeting time correction to ensure acceptance (03:10)
Monitor Retool license activity and connection status, addressing any lack of usage or engagement (02:52)
Reschedule missed meetings with the UK financial client to maintain engagement before their contract renewal period (09:56)

**Logan Bates**
Review the POC success plan shared by Scott to provide feedback or follow-up (01:33)
Investigate Retool platform capabilities on user login tracking to better assess client engagement (01:49)
Assist Scott once his water issue is resolved or if additional help is needed (08:11)
